meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Codex 设为主智能体,接替 Claude 做规划、调用工具并恢复历史会话。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望终端 AI 的规划与工具调度由 Codex 接管。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex to lead planning and tool calls in your terminal instead of Claude.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 的群组可以改用 Codex app-server 作为 agent 后端,负责规划、工具编排、MCP 工具、服务端历史与会话续接;凭据只存 OneCLI vault。
howto.when: 当运维在主机上运行 ncl groups config update --provider codex 并重启该群组时,该群组就改用 Codex。新建群组默认仍是 Claude,除非显式改默认值。

say.text: 跑 provider-auth codex 完成 Codex 认证
say.note: 把认证信息存进 OneCLI vault

say.text: 把 <group-id> 群组的 provider 改成 codex 再重启
say.note: 该群组会用 Codex 作为 agent 后端

say.text: 把默认 provider 设为 codex 后重启 host
say.note: 只影响之后新建的群组

howto.what_en: Installs Codex (codex app-server) as a NanoClaw agent provider: planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history and session resume. Credentials live only in the OneCLI vault.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the operator runs `ncl groups config update --provider codex` for a group and restarts it. New groups still default to Claude unless the instance default is changed.

say_en.text: Run provider-auth codex to finish Codex authentication
say_en.note: Stores the secret in the OneCLI vault

say_en.text: Switch group <group-id> to the codex provider and restart it
say_en.note: That group then runs Codex as its agent backend

say_en.text: Set the default provider to codex and restart the host
